hero.subtitle: One neighbor helping another.
hero.description:
Hi, I'm Kenny.

I spend my weekdays helping people with technology. On Sundays, I volunteer my time to help neighbors across New York City with everyday tech, light household help, and small practical tasks that can make life a little easier.
hero.noCatch:
There's no catch, no sales pitch, and no fees.

Just me using my skills and experience to help my neighbors.
hero.pilotDescription:
Community Sundays is a personal project I work on during my free time. I'm taking it one step at a time, learning how I can better serve my community while helping people who may need an extra hand.

My hope is that this project will grow naturally and, someday, may become a nonprofit dedicated to helping New Yorkers.

about.title: About Me & Why I Started This
about.description1: Support New York isn't a large organization. It's a personal volunteer effort I started to give back to the city I call home.
about.description2: Through my work helping people with technology, I've met many people who feel overwhelmed by technology or simply need help with everyday tasks around the home. I realized that spending a little time with someone — patiently and respectfully — could make a meaningful difference.
about.description3: So I decided to dedicate part of my Sundays to helping, one neighbor at a time.
about.description4: Right now, this is something I run personally during my spare time. Each Sunday helps me learn more about the needs of my community and how I can better support people in the future.
about.quote: I truly enjoy doing this, so please feel free to reach out!

services.title: What I Can Help You With
services.description: When I'm available on Sundays, I'm happy to help my neighbors with everyday technology, simple household tasks, and the little things that can make life a bit easier.
services.note:
All help is free and provided as a personal volunteer effort.

I focus on low-risk, non-invasive help.
For complex repairs or financial accounts, please consult a professional service.

If I'm not the right person for the job, I'll gladly point you in the right direction.
services.notSureDescription: If it's a small everyday problem and I can safely help, I'm always happy to take a look.

categories.title: Accessibility
items: Making phones, tablets, and computers easier to see, hear, and use.

stories.title: Stories from My Sunday Visits
stories.description: These are the personal stories and photos from my Sunday visits. It's incredibly rewarding to see how a little tech help can brighten someone's day.
stories.checkBack: I'm currently putting together some stories to share with you. Please check back soon!
stories.quote: Every Sunday, I'm not just fixing a device—I'm building a bridge to connection for my neighbors.
stories.message: Community Sundays are about more than just technology. They're about making sure our neighbors don't feel left behind in the digital age.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: This is where I'll share updates on my journey from a personal project to a nonprofit, along with news about community events.
notice.stayTuned: Stay tuned as I work toward making this a more formal and sustainable initiative.
notice.serviceAreaMessage: Since I'm doing this personally, I'm currently focused on Manhattan and Williamsburg (Brooklyn). Please email me in advance to confirm if I can make it to your area!

howToApply.title: How to Request My Help
howToApply.description: If you need a hand with technology, I'm happy to help if I can. Please send me an email with:
howToApply.step1: What you need help with (e.g., Wi-Fi issues, smartphone setup)
howToApply.step3: How I can reach you (phone or email)
howToApply.availability: I do this during my personal free time, so availability is limited. I'll do my best to get back to you and schedule a visit.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.description: Have a question, want to volunteer with me, or know someone who needs help? I'd love to hear from you.
contact.volunteerDescription: I'm always happy to meet kind people who would like to volunteer with me on Sundays.

footer.tagline: Personal tech help for my neighbors.
footer.disclaimer: This is a personal volunteer project and is not yet a registered nonprofit.
